commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
Her form and all about her surpass anything he has seen, and he can’t tell what she is.

She of the heavy earrings: is she a goddess who lives in this grove, a peacock chosen from all peacocks, or a human woman? My heart is confused. Her form is beyond painting and she pains him, so “goddess”. Her grace and the grove suggest “peacock”. His heart going to her and her look back suggest “woman”.
